status: PROPOSED - this answers the problem statement's Stage 01 Team Huddle (acceptable false-alarm threshold). Ratify on Day 1 and record in docs/decisions/.
unit: relative cost units (1.0 = cost of one unnecessary emergency reroute escalation)
reading_guide: Row = what really happened, column = what we predicted. Example: truth CRITICAL_DELAY but we said ON_TIME costs 10 units (missed bottleneck). Truth ON_TIME but we said CRITICAL_DELAY costs 1 unit (wasted emergency reroute).
operating_point_rule: Choose the decision threshold on the VALIDATION split by minimising expected cost; report the TEST result at that frozen threshold. Never tune a threshold on the test split.

alert_budget.note: Soft ceiling used to discuss the trade-off in debate. Evaluation Engineer reports where each model sits relative to it.
